title: New villages on the moors and the badlands
changes: Five villages now stand along the highways: Turfhallow, Blackwater Staithe and Barrowstead on the Grey Barrow Moors, Redlode and Hornstead in the Red Badlands. Follow the signposted dirt paths off the road.
Each village has a portal stone on its square, a villager with a short local quest, and someone to talk to or trade with. Blackwater Staithe sells flasks and Redlode sells armour.
Monsters stay out of the villages.
The clans can fight over the villages like the towns: when a village's land changes hands, its gate is contested. A held village adds half a town's income to its clan.
